note: Data the design_rules static row reads. settings holds the expected definition of every setting that exists, keyed by its config.lua key; a change that adds a setting adds its row here.

scale.source: terra-nauvis-scale (startup, string, default 6): the world's scale, one of the listed values

spawn_city_europe.source: terra-nauvis-spawn-city-europe: random plus 40 of EarthMaps' 41 Europe cities, default random; Luxembourg is left out (data-src/approvals/approvals-data.json cities.europe.dropdown)

spawn_city_atlantic.source: terra-nauvis-spawn-city-atlantic: random plus all 50 EarthMaps cities (EarthMaps settings.lua:92-105), default random; none is left out on this map (data-src/approvals/approvals-data.json cities.atlantic.dropdown); appended values (frankfurt, moscow, null) keep every earlier value's number

spawn_city_olde_world.source: terra-nauvis-spawn-city-old-world: random plus all 30 EarthMaps cities (EarthMaps settings.lua:124-137), default random; none is left out on this map (data-src/approvals/approvals-data.json cities.olde_world.dropdown); frankfurt, aachen and moscow are appended, so every earlier value keeps its number

koppen.source: terra-nauvis-koppen: Koppen biomes (startup, bool; default on in 0.4.0). Shelved in 1.0.0: the setting is hidden and pinned off (hidden with forced_value false, default off), so new worlds take the continuous 0.3.2 climate and worlds made with it on keep their Koppen names

canals.source: terra-nauvis-canals (startup, bool, default on). 1.0.0 (fewer settings): hidden and pinned on (hidden with forced_value true); a world keeps the value its preset baked

great_forests.source: terra-nauvis-great-forests (startup, bool, default on). 1.0.0 (fewer settings): hidden and pinned on (hidden with forced_value true); a world keeps the value its preset baked

hotspot_amount.source: terra-nauvis-hotspot-amount: hotspots listen only to mod settings; startup, a dropdown of 50, 100, 200 and 400 percent, default 100. 1.0.0 (fewer settings): hidden and pinned at 100 by a one-entry allowed_values, since forced_value pins bool settings only; a world keeps the amount its preset baked

regional_scarcity.source: terra-nauvis-regional-scarcity (0.3.0): regional scarcity of regular ore past about 1,500 tiles at scale 12; startup, a dropdown of off, medium and strong, default medium

inland_lakes.source: terra-nauvis-inland-lakes, added after the first playtest (by default no random lakes, only the lake at the chosen spawn city): startup, bool, default off

moscow_zone.source: terra-nauvis-moscow-zone (0.3.1): startup, a dropdown of normal, chaos and corrupted, default normal, needs Alien Biomes

blue_corrupted.source: terra-nauvis-blue-corrupted, blue corrupted UK and Australia: startup, bool, default off, needs Alien Biomes

north_snow.source: terra-nauvis-north-snow (0.3.1), North snow: startup, a dropdown of low, medium and high, default medium

exact_coast.source: terra-nauvis-exact-coast (startup, bool, default on; it began as default off and was flipped to on for Old World and Atlantic, a data edit). 1.0.0 (fewer settings): hidden and pinned on (hidden with forced_value true); a world keeps the key its preset baked
